description: Build a request for Maglev to buy listed parts, price unlisted ones, or make custom versions. Returns the request document and a drafted email. It takes no name, email address or company: the email ends with a line your person fills in before sending. Nothing is sent or ordered: show it to your person first.
name: build_rfq

error.description: Set when the tool could not answer; the other fields are then absent.
